images.alt: Cross-section diagram of skin showing what causes dull, uneven tone: soft brown pigment clusters gathering in the granular layer, grey oxidative-stress particles settling onto the surface, and dead surface cells piling up as cell turnover slows.

Cross-section diagram of the antioxidant approach to brightening: glutathione tripeptide chains, vitamin C crystals and supporting peptides descending in glassy spheres into the skin's surface layers, breaking up grey oxidative-stress particles as they arrive.
